text:
I use `origin/main`, because `--rebase` has no base argument. I do not use `origin/release/2`.

Below, `W` means the absolute path to `.worktrees/pr-412` under the supplied working directory. `H` means the SHA returned by `git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD` after the rebase; `H7` is its first seven characters. The digest does not supply that resulting SHA, so I use these symbols rather than invent one.

## 1. Initialize progress and enter sync

I initialize `plan_tracker` with:

- `gather`: complete.
- `provision`: complete.
- `sync`: in progress.
- `verify`: pending.

The first two stages have already finished. I read `reference/sync.md`.

The helper facility exists, and `head_pushable` is true. I run, in order:

```sh
git -C "$W" fetch origin main
git -C "$W" show-ref --verify refs/remotes/origin/main
git -C "$W" merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD
git -C "$W" rev-list --merges origin/main..HEAD
```

The ref exists, the ancestry check exits 1, and the merge-commit list is empty.

I refresh the remote head and record the local baseline:

```sh
gh pr view 412 --json headRefOid
git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD
```

Both return:

```text
7c1e9a2f4b0d6e8a1c3f5b7d9e0a2c4e6f8a0b1c
```

The authenticated viewer is the author. The invocation authorizes this sync; I do not ask for other-author confirmation.

## 2. Rebase, then review before pushing

I run:

```sh
git -C "$W" rebase origin/main
git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD
git -C "$W" status --porcelain
```

The rebase completes without conflicts, the second command records `H`, and the worktree is clean. I dispatch no conflict-resolution implementer and run no `rebase --continue`.

I allocate the review output outside the worktree:

```sh
mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-sync-review.XXXXXX"
```

I dispatch:

```text
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: W,
  task: ...
})
```

The task names `H` and the allocated output path. Its rules are:

- Confirm that the worktree HEAD is `H` before working.
- Work read-only in this worktree.
- Review "rebase replay and conflict resolutions" using:

  git -C "$W" range-diff origin/main \
    7c1e9a2f4b0d6e8a1c3f5b7d9e0a2c4e6f8a0b1c HEAD

- There were no conflict stops, so there is no resolved-file diff.
- Do not edit, stage, commit, or push.
- Write the native findings report to the allocated output path, with no closure lines.

I await the helper and read its output. It is clean.

## 3. Push the rewritten head

I run exactly one push:

```sh
git -C "$W" push --no-follow-tags \
  --force-with-lease=feature/ledger-rounding:7c1e9a2f4b0d6e8a1c3f5b7d9e0a2c4e6f8a0b1c \
  git@git.example.invalid:orchard/ledger.git \
  HEAD:refs/heads/feature/ledger-rounding
```

The lease push succeeds. I do not push to `origin`, retry the push, or start a fix wave.

I obtain the before-and-after commit counts:

```sh
git -C "$W" rev-list --count \
  origin/main..7c1e9a2f4b0d6e8a1c3f5b7d9e0a2c4e6f8a0b1c
git -C "$W" rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD
```

Both counts are 4, giving zero dropped commits.

## 4. Refresh the digest and trusted configuration

I repeat the step-1 forge reads, not the ticket reads. The reads cover the authenticated viewer, repository permissions, PR metadata, commits, files, diff, checks, workflow runs, comments, and reviews:

```sh
gh api user
gh repo view orchard/ledger --json nameWithOwner,viewerPermission
gh api repos/orchard/ledger

gh pr view 412 --repo orchard/ledger \
  --json number,url,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,headRefOid,isCrossRepository,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner,maintainerCanModify,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup

gh api --paginate repos/orchard/ledger/pulls/412/commits
gh api --paginate repos/orchard/ledger/pulls/412/files
gh pr diff 412 --repo orchard/ledger
gh pr checks 412 --repo orchard/ledger

gh api --paginate \
  "repos/orchard/ledger/actions/runs?head_sha=$H"

gh api --paginate repos/orchard/ledger/pulls/412/comments
gh api --paginate repos/orchard/ledger/issues/412/comments
gh api --paginate repos/orchard/ledger/pulls/412/reviews
```

The refreshed digest names `H`. The old successful test check does not count as evidence for `H`. The refreshed results contain the failed `ci / test` check and the queued reviewer workflow.

I run:

```sh
git -C "$W" merge-base origin/main HEAD
```

At that merge-base, I re-resolve the configuration ladder described by `reference/assessment.md`. I read the applicable overrides, rubric, verification command, and ladder sources from that trusted commit, not from `H`. Their concrete paths and command text belong to the already-resolved step-2 configuration and are not supplied in this exercise.

I record:

```text
rebased 7c1e9a2..H7 onto origin/main, 0 commit(s) dropped as already applied
```

I mark `sync` complete and start `verify`. The successful sync stays complete even though testing on its pushed head fails.

## 5. Verify the pushed head

I read `verification-brief.md` Section B and allocate:

```sh
mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-verify.XXXXXX"
```

I dispatch:

```text
subagent({
  agent: "worker",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: W,
  task: ...
})
```

The task carries:

- The assessed SHA `H`, the refreshed digest, the step-2 ticket extraction, and the configuration resolved from the merge-base.
- A requirement to confirm `HEAD == H` before working.
- The complete Section B duty and evidence-resolution rules.
- CI-first verification, using evidence belonging to `H`.
- One disposition per material claim, with evidence and locators.
- No edits, commits, pushes, reviews, comments, or tracker writes.
- The allocated output path and the evidence-record output contract.

The helper performs the first verification poll against `H`. The test check is already terminal with failure, so it needs no 30-second retry cycle. The queued reviewer workflow is recorded for the reviewer overlay; it does not turn the failed test check into green evidence.

The helper records the three failed assertions in `src/ledger/round.test.ts`. It does not run local verification to replace functioning, failed CI, and it does not automatically fix anything.

I await the helper and read its output. I add one tracker task for each material claim it assessed and record its terminal disposition. Under the exercise's clean-helper-result rule, the mechanism assessment produces no additional source finding. The failed CI check remains undispositioned; I do not label it flaky or infrastructure-broken.

I close `verify` as failed because verification on `H` failed. It remains failed at the menu.

## 6. Review after the verification output exists

Only now do I add the remaining tracker stages:

- `review`
- `report`
- `menu`

I start `review`, read Section C and `review-baseline.md`, and allocate:

```sh
mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-review.XXXXXX"
```

I dispatch:

```text
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: W,
  task: ...
})
```

The task carries:

- `H` as the assessed head and a requirement to verify it before working.
- The refreshed digest, the existing Verify output path, the ticket extraction, and the trusted rubric.
- Section C plus `review-baseline.md`.
- Read-only source review of the diff and the human's bankers-rounding comment.
- An internal comment ledger, including the queued reviewer workflow.
- No external posting or worktree mutation.
- The allocated output path and the findings-and-ledger output contract.

I await the helper and read its output. It adds no source blocker or drafted reply. The queued forge reviewer remains pending; this completed local review does not complete that separate workflow.

I mark `review` complete.

## 7. Integrate and render

I read `reference/findings.md`, then `reference/report.md`. The brief assesses **`H`, the rebased and pushed SHA**, not `7c1e9a2f4b0d6e8a1c3f5b7d9e0a2c4e6f8a0b1c`.

I retain the failing check as one merge blocker. I keep drafted payloads out of the report and make no code or documentation edits. No acceptance-criterion text or post-merge observation is supplied in the exercise, so I do not invent numbered AC coverage.

I mark `report` complete, read `reference/decision-menu.md`, and render the first menu. The pending reviewer puts `wait` first, but the existing blocker keeps `fix` recommended on the author's own PR. No mutation follows without a pick.

In the following rendered sync line, `H7` denotes the actual seven-character pushed SHA recorded above.

---

Delivers: This PR implements half-up rounding for ledger totals for gh-388. The supplied digest does not include acceptance-criterion text or identify an observation to check after merge.

PR comments:
- The reviewer workflow is queued, so merge waits. (reviewer)

Blockers:
1. The pushed head fails three rounding assertions, so verification does not pass on the assessed head. (ci / test, src/ledger/round.test.ts)

Sync: rebased 7c1e9a2..H7 onto origin/main, 0 commit(s) dropped as already applied
Verdict: fixable - 1 blocker

1. wait - poll the reviewer run and refresh comments, then re-render
2. fix - apply the drafted blocker fix in the worktree, review the wave, and push [recommended]
3. review - post the blocker as a comment on your PR
4. show evidence - display the evidence record and drafted payload
5. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number, or compose: "fix 1". Not offered: merge (ci / test failing), merge anyway (ci / test failing). To disposition the failing check, type "check ci / test flaky | real | ci-broken".

rationale.anthropic-fable/claude-fable-5-1:medium: The narration runs sync, lease push, refresh, verify, review, and report in order with named commands and persona-plus-rules dispatches, records the failed check and queued reviewer on the pushed head, dispatches no automatic fix, and renders a fixable verdict with the templated Sync line and menu.
